raw:
@q query
  select ?source
  where match
    relation "obtain from"
    role subject "the income certificate for the social scholarship"
    role object ?source
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare any
  then
    ?source equal "ANAF"
    ?source equal "the employer"
  end
